Supplier.definition: Organization that supplies purchased components to ForgeWorks.

Component.definition: Purchased item used in manufacturing a product.

Product.definition: Finished item ForgeWorks sells, built from components listed in its bill of materials.

Customer.definition: Organization purchasing industrial equipment from ForgeWorks.

SalesOrder.definition: Customer commercial commitment recorded in the sales system.

SalesOrderLine.definition: Individual product and quantity within a sales order.

Shipment.definition: Dispatch of goods against one sales order; carries its own fee at shipment grain.

Net order value.definition: Line quantity times unit price minus line discount, summed at order-line grain.

Open order value.definition: Approved net line value for currently open sales orders in the educational model.

Shipping fees.definition: Fees charged per shipment, summed at shipment grain and never through order lines.

Connected exposure.definition: Net value of open sales order lines whose product uses a specified component. A structural fact at order-line grain; not a delay, loss or risk prediction.

Component shortfall.definition: Units of a component required by open connected lines minus units on hand, floored at zero. A screen on a snapshot, not an allocation.

Timing slack.definition: Promised day minus the delayed component's revised arrival day. Ignores production and transit lead time.

Recovery action.definition: A proposed operational intervention subject to feasibility and approval.
